response.sql: WITH trader_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT tradekind, record_count, SUM(record_count) OVER () as total_records, record_count::float / SUM(record_count) OVER () as share, AVG(record_count) OVER () as avg_count FROM trader_counts) SELECT SUM(record_count) as combined_number, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(record_count - avg_count) as average_above_average FROM stats WHERE record_count > avg_count
